description: R08 DeserializationTests fragment seam: portable Rust owns fragment profile updates, runtime-only fragment actions, ignored fragment keys, nested/iterable commands and fragment non-persistence across user-settings roundtrip.

entries.notes: FragmentSettings composes the existing layered profile owner, targets the two exact built-in GUIDs through `updates`, permits the native name override, appends the exact third profile vector and does not report a duplicate.
A named fragment action with an explicit ID is materialized in the runtime fragment overlay and remains discoverable by name.

The fragment action is present by name while its legacy `keys` member is deliberately ignored; lookup still delegates to the pre-fragment ActionMap, so preexisting bindings remain authoritative and ctrl+f stays unbound for the Microsoft vector.
The exact two-child nested fragment command is retained as a named runtime command with nested-command state.
An unnamed nested fragment command is ignored without producing a CascadiaSettings warning, matching the native observable directly.
The exact iterateOn=schemes template materializes as a nested runtime command whose expanded child count equals the current effective color-scheme collection size.
Fragment actions are runtime-only: they exist after fragment layering but are absent from the base user-owned ActionMap that is observed after serialization/reload without the fragment.
